ground_truth.title: Leave your resume or CV to the experts
ground_truth.main_content:
HigherEdJobs has partnered with TopResume, one of the leading resume writing services,
to offer exclusive pricing to the HigherEdJobs community.
TopResume's team of Certified Professional Resume Writers
have years of experience reviewing resumes and CVs for college
faculty and administrators. With their support, you'll get the resume or CV you need to advance your career.

Questions?
support@topresume.com

How it Works

1

Getting to Know You

In just 5 minutes, you answer a few simple questions that provide TopResume the information
they need to get you the best resume or CV possible.

2

Meet Your Match

TopResume will match you with the writer best suited to your industry and experience.
They'll work their magic.

3

Review First Draft

Have notes or questions about your first draft? Send them to your writer and they'll
revise your document.

Final Resume or CV

Download your final draft and get ready for a renewed job search!
